output.text:
This design is overly bloated with three caches that aren’t connected to anything.

**Problem:** The three caches (Catalog cache, Search cache, Users cache) are not wired into any service besides the DBs behind them and have no clear way to be populated or read from. In a real design you’d have one authoritative cache per function, backed by those DBs but also exposed via your API layer so it’s usable for reads.

**Fix:** Remove two of the caches. Keep one per domain. I’ll remove the Catalog cache and Users cache, leaving the Search cache (the domain with highest read pressure). After the removal, verify the diagram still makes sense.
